name: Juçara palm
desc: An Atlantic Forest palm harvested for heart of palm until it became uncommon. Its fruits are a food for forest birds and mammals.
about: Euterpe edulis, commonly known as juçara, jussara (an archaic alternative spelling), açaí-do-sul or palmiteiro, is a palm species in the genus Euterpe. It is now predominantly used for hearts of palm.
